decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The demolition of an existing conservatory and erection of a single storey rear extension to the existing ground floor flat, as shown on drawing numbers 0609/01 to 0609/04, received 09 November 2006, would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies ENV-B.1.1 New Development, H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the north and south flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of an existing conservatory and erection of a new single storey rear extension to the existing ground floor flat.
